en: Proverbs 8

p.src: 1  Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

en: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
u.src: 1  Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

p.src: 2  On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

en: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
u.src: 2  On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

p.src: 3  Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

en: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
u.src: 3  Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

p.src: 4  “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

en: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
u.src: 4  “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

p.src: 5  You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

en: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
u.src: 5  You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

p.src: 6  Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

en: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
u.src: 6  Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

p.src: 7  For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

en: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
u.src: 7  For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

p.src: 8  All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
u.src: 8  All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

p.src: 9  They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

en: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
u.src: 9  They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

p.src: 10  Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

en: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
u.src: 10  Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

p.src: 11  For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

en: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
u.src: 11  For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

p.src: 12  “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

en: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
u.src: 12  “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

p.src: 13  The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

en: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
u.src: 13  The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

p.src: 14  Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

en: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
u.src: 14  Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

p.src: 15  By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
u.src: 15  By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

p.src: 16  By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

en: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
u.src: 16  By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

p.src: 17  I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

en: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
u.src: 17  I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

p.src: 18  With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

en: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
u.src: 18  With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

p.src: 19  My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

en: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
u.src: 19  My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

p.src: 20  I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

en: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
u.src: 20  I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

p.src: 21  that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

en: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
u.src: 21  that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

p.src: 22  “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

en: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
u.src: 22  “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

p.src: 23  I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
u.src: 23  I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

p.src: 24  When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

en: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
u.src: 24  When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

p.src: 25  Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

en: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
u.src: 25  Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

p.src: 26  while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

en: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
u.src: 26  while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

p.src: 27  When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

en: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
u.src: 27  When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

p.src: 28  when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

en: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
u.src: 28  when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

p.src: 29  when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

en: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
u.src: 29  when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

p.src: 30  then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

en: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
u.src: 30  then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

p.src: 31  rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

en: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
u.src: 31  rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

p.src: 32  “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

en: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
u.src: 32  “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

p.src: 33  Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

en: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
u.src: 33  Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

p.src: 34  Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

en: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
u.src: 34  Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

p.src: 35  For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

en: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.
u.src: 35  For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

p.src: 36  But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

en: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
u.src: 36  But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
